title: Add coupon codes to checkout
body:
## Summary

Customers can now pass a couponCode when they check out. SAVE10 gives 10 percent off and WELCOME5 gives 5.00 off.

## Changes

* New coupons module with SAVE10 and WELCOME5
* Pricing applies the discount to the total
* POST /api/orders accepts couponCode

## How to test

Add an item to the cart, then POST /api/orders with {"couponCode": "SAVE10"} and check totals.

verixa_should_cover: Valid percent coupon reduces the total by 10 percent
Fixed coupon on a cart cheaper than 5.00 must not make the total negative (BUG: it does)
Checkout without a coupon still works
